newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kinkel to meet Serbian opposition leader in Bonn.
newsitem.headline: Kinkel to meet Serbian opposition leader in Bonn.

text.p: Germany's Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel will hold talks with Serbian opposition leader Zoran Djindjic on Sunday in Bonn, the foreign ministry said on Friday.

The two men will discuss the current situation in Belgrade, where opposition "Zajedno" (Together) supporters have protested for more than two months against the Serbian authorities' annulment of municipal polls in 14 of 18 major cities.

The announcement came a day after Kinkel expressed Bonn's sympathy for the opposition in Belgrade and called on Serbian President Slobodan Milosevic to recognise opposition victories in last November's polls.
Kinkel also urged members of the Serbian opposition to spell out their future policies more clearly -- particularly on minorities such as ethnic Albanians in the province of Kosovo.
Djindjic is due to arrive in Bonn on Saturday evening. He meets Kinkel for an hour on Sunday morning and then flies back to Belgrade, a ministry spokesman said.
